results.stderr:
Download and analyze agentic workflow logs and artifacts from GitHub Actions.

This command fetches workflow runs, downloads their artifacts, and extracts them into
organized folders named by run ID. It also provides an overview table with aggregate
metrics including duration, token usage, and cost information.

Pass multiple workflow arguments to download them concurrently and produce one combined
report. Cross-repository targets accept owner/repo/workflow or
[HOST/]owner/repo/.github/workflows/workflow.yml paths. The count limit applies per workflow.

By default, only the compact usage artifact is downloaded (token usage, run metadata).
Use --artifacts all to download all artifacts, or specify individual sets such as
--artifacts agent,firewall to fetch only what you need.

All available artifact sets: activation, agent, all, detection, evals, experiment, firewall, github-api, graders, mcp, usage.

Downloaded artifacts include (when using --artifacts all):
- Workflow metadata: Engine configuration and run metadata
- safe_output.jsonl: Agent's final output content (available when non-empty)
- agent_output/: Agent logs directory (if the workflow produced logs)
- agent-stdio.log: Agent standard output/error logs
- aw.patch: Git patch of changes made during execution (legacy; see aw-{branch}.patch)
- aw-{branch}.patch: Git patch of changes for each branch (one file per PR/push)
- workflow-logs/: GitHub Actions workflow run logs (job logs organized in subdirectory)
- summary.json: Complete metrics and run data for all downloaded runs


The workflow-id is the basename of the Markdown file without the .md extension.
You can provide either the workflow-id (e.g., 'ci-doctor') or the full filename (e.g., 'ci-doctor.md').

Usage:
  gh aw logs [workflow]... [flags]

Examples:
  # Basic usage
  gh aw logs                           # Download logs for all workflows
  gh aw logs weekly-research           # Download logs for a specific workflow
  gh aw logs workflow-a workflow-b     # Download and combine reports concurrently
  gh aw logs owner/repo/workflow-a     # Download using a full repository/workflow path
  gh aw logs owner/repo/.github/workflows/workflow-a.yml # Full workflow file path
  gh aw logs weekly-research.md        # Download logs (alternative format)
  gh aw logs -c 10                     # Download last 10 matching runs

  # Date filtering
  gh aw logs --start-date 2024-01-01   # Download up to 10 runs after date
  gh aw logs --end-date 2024-01-31     # Download up to 10 runs before date
  gh aw logs --start-date -1w          # Download up to 10 runs from last week
  gh aw logs --start-date -1w -c 5     # Download up to 5 runs from last week
  gh aw logs --end-date -1d            # Download up to 10 runs before yesterday
  gh aw logs --start-date -1mo         # Download up to 10 runs from last month

  # Content filtering
  gh aw logs --engine claude           # Filter logs by claude engine
  gh aw logs --engine codex            # Filter logs by codex engine
  gh aw logs --engine copilot          # Filter logs by copilot engine
  gh aw logs --runtime gvisor          # Filter logs by sandbox agent runtime
  gh aw logs --firewall                # Filter logs with firewall enabled
  gh aw logs --no-firewall             # Filter logs without firewall
  gh aw logs --safe-output missing-tool     # Filter logs with missing-tool messages
  gh aw logs --safe-output missing-data     # Filter logs with missing-data messages
  gh aw logs --safe-output create-issue     # Filter logs with create-issue messages
  gh aw logs --safe-output noop             # Filter logs with noop messages
  gh aw logs --safe-output report-incomplete # Filter logs with report-incomplete messages
  gh aw logs --ref main                # Filter logs by branch or tag
  gh aw logs --ref feature-xyz         # Filter logs by feature branch
  gh aw logs --filtered-integrity      # Filter logs containing items that were filtered by gateway integrity checks
  gh aw logs --evals                    # Filter logs from workflows with evals results
  gh aw logs --graders                  # Filter logs from workflows with grader results
  gh aw logs --exclude-staged          # Exclude staged workflow runs from results

  # Run ID range filtering
  gh aw logs --after-run-id 1000       # Filter runs after run ID 1000
  gh aw logs --before-run-id 2000      # Filter runs before run ID 2000
  gh aw logs --after-run-id 1000 --before-run-id 2000  # Filter runs in range

  # Artifact selection (default: usage only - the compact conclusion artifact)
  gh aw logs --artifacts all           # Download all artifacts (agent logs, firewall, etc.)
  gh aw logs --artifacts agent         # Download only agent logs
  gh aw logs --artifacts agent,firewall # Download agent and firewall artifacts
  gh aw logs --artifacts mcp           # Download only MCP gateway logs

  # Output options (default output is compact format optimized for agents)
  gh aw logs -o ./my-logs              # Custom output directory
  gh aw logs --tool-graph              # Generate Mermaid tool sequence graph
  gh aw logs --parse                   # Parse logs and generate Markdown reports
  gh aw logs --audit                   # Generate audit.json for each downloaded run
  gh aw logs -v                        # Verbose compact output (extra columns + sections)
  gh aw logs --json                    # JSON format (compact by default, use -v for full)
  gh aw logs --json -v                 # Full JSON with audit metadata
  gh aw logs --format tsv              # Tab-separated (minimal, raw data)
  gh aw logs --format console          # Decorated console tables (human-friendly)
  gh aw logs --format markdown         # Cross-run security audit report (Markdown)
  gh aw logs --format pretty           # Cross-run security audit report (console)
  gh aw logs weekly-research --format markdown --last 10  # Cross-run report for last 10 runs
  gh aw logs --train                   # Train log pattern weights from last 10 runs
  gh aw logs my-workflow --train -c 50 # Train log pattern weights from up to 50 runs of a specific workflow

  # Cross-repository
  gh aw logs weekly-research --repo owner/repo  # Download logs from specific repository

  # Resource budgets
  gh aw logs --timeout 30 --max-github-api-rate-limit 12000 # Wait after 12000 core API requests are used
  gh aw logs --timeout 30 --max-github-api-rate-limit -2000 # Keep 2000 core API requests available
  gh aw logs --timeout 30 --max-storage 10240                # Prune cache data and stop downloads at 10 GB
  gh aw logs --max-storage 10240 --prune-older-runs          # Remove oldest runs if cache pruning is insufficient

  # Cache maintenance
  gh aw logs --cache-before -1w          # Evict local cache older than 1 week before downloading runs
  gh aw logs --cache-before -30d         # Evict local cache older than 30 days before downloading runs
  gh aw logs --cache-before -1mo         # Evict local cache older than 1 month before downloading runs
  gh aw logs --cache-before 2024-01-01   # Evict local cache older than 2024-01-01 before downloading runs

Flags:
      --after-run-id int                Filter runs with database ID after this value (exclusive)
      --artifacts strings               Artifact sets to download (default: usage — compact summary for faster downloads). Use 'all' for everything, or comma-separate sets. Valid sets: activation, agent, all, detection, evals, experiment, firewall, github-api, graders, mcp, usage (default [usage])
      --audit                           Generate audit.json in each workflow run cache directory (comparisons use downloaded runs only)
      --before-run-id int               Filter runs with database ID before this value (exclusive)
      --cache-before string             (Cache eviction) Evict locally cached run folders for runs before this date, prior to downloading. Accepts deltas like -1d, -1w, -1mo (or explicit day counts like -30d), or an absolute date YYYY-MM-DD. Unlike --start-date, this only clears local cache and does not filter which runs are fetched.
  -c, --count int                       Maximum matching workflow runs to return per workflow (after applying filters) (default 10)
      --end-date string                 Filter runs created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or delta like -1d, -1w, -1mo)
  -e, --engine string                   Filter logs by AI engine (copilot, claude, codex, gemini, pi)
      --evals                           Filter to runs containing evals results (evals.jsonl); automatically includes the usage artifact (which contains evals)
      --exclude-staged                  Exclude workflow runs that executed in staged mode (safe outputs previewed but not applied)
      --filtered-integrity              Filter to runs containing items that were filtered by gateway integrity checks
      --firewall                        Filter to only runs with firewall enabled
      --format string                   Output format: console (decorated tables), tsv (tab-separated), pretty (cross-run report), markdown (cross-run Markdown). Default: compact agent-optimized output
      --graders                         Filter to runs containing deterministic grader results; automatically includes grader artifacts
  -h, --help                            Show help for gh aw logs
  -j, --json                            Output results in JSON format
      --last int                        Alias for --count/-c: number of recent runs to download
      --max-github-api-rate-limit int   Maximum used GitHub core API requests before waiting for reset (positive = absolute, negative = reserve from API limit; e.g. 12000 or -2000)
      --max-storage int                 Maximum logs storage in MB after pruning non-essential cache data (0 = unlimited)
      --no-firewall                     Filter to only runs without firewall enabled
  -o, --output string                   Output directory for generated files (default ".github/aw/logs")
      --parse                           Run JavaScript parsers on agent logs and firewall logs, writing Markdown to log.md and firewall.md
      --prune-older-runs                Remove oldest completed runs when non-essential cache pruning cannot satisfy --max-storage
      --ref string                      Filter runs by branch or tag name (e.g., main, v1.0.0)
  -r, --repo string                     Target repository ([HOST/]owner/repo format). Defaults to current repository
      --report-file string              Write --format markdown output directly to this file path instead of stdout (creates parent directories as needed)
      --runtime string                  Filter to runs using a specific sandbox agent runtime (e.g., gvisor, docker-sbx, cloud-hypervisor)
      --safe-output string              Filter to runs containing a specific safe output type (e.g., create-issue, missing-tool, missing-data, noop, report-incomplete)
      --start-date string               Filter runs created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or delta like -1d, -1w, -1mo)
      --stdin                           Read workflow run IDs or URLs from stdin (one per line) instead of discovering runs via the GitHub API
      --summary-file string             Path to write the summary JSON file relative to output directory (use empty string to disable) (default "summary.json")
      --timeout int                     Download timeout in minutes (0 = no timeout)
      --tool-graph                      Generate Mermaid tool sequence graph from agent logs
      --train                           Analyze log patterns across downloaded runs and save pattern weights to drain3_weights.json in the output directory

Global Flags:
      --banner    Display ASCII logo banner with purple GitHub color theme
  -v, --verbose   Enable verbose output showing detailed information

Audit one or more workflow runs by downloading artifacts and logs, detecting errors,
analyzing MCP tool usage, and generating a concise report suitable for AI agents.

When a single run is provided, generates a detailed Markdown report for that run.
When two or more runs are provided, the first is used as the base (reference) and the
remaining runs are compared against it, producing a diff report.

Each argument accepts:
- A numeric run ID (e.g., 1234567890)
- A GitHub Actions run URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890)
- A GitHub Actions job URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890/job/9876543210)
- A GitHub Actions job URL with step (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890/job/9876543210#step:7:1)
- A GitHub workflow run URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/runs/1234567890)
- GitHub Enterprise URLs (e.g., https://github.example.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890)

When a job URL is provided (single-run mode only):
- If a step number is included (#step:7:1), extracts that specific step's output
- If no step number, finds and extracts the first failing step's output
- Saves job logs to the output directory

Usage:
  gh aw audit <run-id-or-url> [run-id-or-url]... [flags]

Examples:
  gh aw audit 1234567890 --repo owner/repo  # Audit with bare run ID (--repo required)
  gh aw audit https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890  # Audit from run URL
  gh aw audit https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890/job/9876543210  # Audit job and extract first failing step
  gh aw audit https://github.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890/job/9876543210#step:7:1  # Extract step 7 output
  gh aw audit https://github.com/owner/repo/runs/1234567890  # Audit from workflow run URL
  gh aw audit https://github.example.com/owner/repo/actions/runs/1234567890  # Audit from GitHub Enterprise
  gh aw audit 1234567890 -o ./audit-reports # Custom output directory
  gh aw audit 1234567890 -v                 # Verbose output
  gh aw audit 1234567890 --parse            # Parse agent logs and firewall logs, generating log.md and firewall.md
  gh aw audit 1234567890 --repo owner/repo  # Audit run from a specific repository
  gh aw audit 1234567890 1234567891         # Diff two runs (base vs comparison)
  gh aw audit 1234567890 1234567891 1234567892  # Diff base against multiple runs
  gh aw audit 1234567890 1234567891 --format markdown  # Markdown diff output for PR comments
  gh aw audit 1234567890 --runtime gvisor   # Skip run unless sandbox agent runtime matches

Flags:
      --artifacts strings   Artifact sets to download (default: all — comprehensive artifacts required for analysis). Valid sets: activation, agent, all, detection, evals, experiment, firewall, github-api, graders, mcp, usage
      --evals               Filter to runs containing evals results (evals.jsonl); automatically downloads the usage artifact (which includes evals) when --artifacts is narrowed
      --experiment string   Filter to runs that include this experiment name
      --format string       Diff output format for multi-run mode: pretty, markdown (default "pretty")
  -h, --help                Show help for gh aw audit
  -j, --json                Output results in JSON format
  -o, --output string       Output directory for generated files (default ".github/aw/logs")
      --parse               Run JavaScript parsers on agent logs and firewall logs, writing Markdown to log.md and firewall.md
  -r, --repo string         Target repository ([HOST/]owner/repo format). Defaults to current repository
      --runtime string      Filter to runs using a specific sandbox agent runtime (e.g., gvisor, docker-sbx, cloud-hypervisor)
      --stdin               Read workflow run IDs or URLs from stdin (one per line) instead of positional arguments
      --variant string      Filter to runs with a specific variant value (requires --experiment)

Global Flags:
      --banner    Display ASCII logo banner with purple GitHub color theme
  -v, --verbose   Enable verbose output showing detailed information

Show status of all agentic workflows in the repository.

Displays a table with workflow name, AI engine, compilation status, enabled/disabled state,
and time remaining until expiration (if stop-after is configured).

The optional pattern argument filters workflows by name (case-insensitive substring match).
It accepts workflow IDs (basename without .md) or full filenames.

Usage:
  gh aw status [pattern] [flags]

Examples:
  gh aw status                           # Show all workflow status
  gh aw status ci-                       # Show workflows with 'ci-' in name
  gh aw status --json                    # Output in JSON format
  gh aw status --ref main                # Show latest run status for main branch
  gh aw status --label automation        # Show workflows with 'automation' label
  gh aw status --repo owner/other-repo   # Check status in different repository

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for gh aw status
  -j, --json           Output results in JSON format
      --label string   Filter workflows by label
      --ref string     Filter runs by branch or tag name (e.g., main, v1.0.0)
  -r, --repo string    Target repository ([HOST/]owner/repo format). Defaults to current repository

Global Flags:
      --banner    Display ASCII logo banner with purple GitHub color theme
  -v, --verbose   Enable verbose output showing detailed information

Compile agentic workflow Markdown files into GitHub Actions YAML.

If no workflows are specified, all Markdown files in .github/workflows will be compiled.

The workflow-id is the basename of the Markdown file without the .md extension.
You can provide either the workflow-id (e.g., 'ci-doctor') or the full filename (e.g., 'ci-doctor.md').

The --dependabot flag generates dependency manifests when dependencies are detected:
  - For npm: Creates package.json and package-lock.json (requires npm in PATH)
  - For Python: Creates requirements.txt for pip packages
  - For Go: Creates go.mod for go install/get packages
  - For all detected ecosystems: Generates .github/dependabot.yml
  - Use --force to overwrite existing dependabot.yml
  - Cannot be used with specific workflow files or custom --dir
  - Only processes workflows in the default .github/workflows directory

Action mode controls how gh-aw action scripts are referenced in compiled workflows.
Three flags govern this. --gh-aw-ref is mutually exclusive with the other two;
--action-tag and --action-mode may be combined (e.g. --action-mode action --action-tag v1.2.3):

Unlike `gh aw upgrade`, `gh aw compile` only applies codemods when you opt in with `--fix`.

  --action-mode <mode>
    Explicit mode selection. Values:
      dev      Local paths (./actions/...). For developing inside the gh-aw repo.
      release  SHA-pinned refs from github/gh-aw (e.g. github/gh-aw/actions/setup@<sha>).
               The SHA is derived from the binary version or from --action-tag.
      action   SHA-pinned refs from the github/gh-aw-actions repository.
               Used by release binaries. Can be combined with --action-tag to pin a version.
    Auto-detected from the binary build type when not set.

  --action-tag <sha-or-tag>
    Pin to a specific SHA or version tag (e.g. v1, v1.2.3, <full-sha>).
    Implies --action-mode release unless --action-mode action is also specified.
    The value is used as-is without SHA resolution. Use --gh-aw-ref to resolve
    branches or tags at compile time.

  --gh-aw-ref <branch-tag-or-sha>
    Resolve a branch name, tag, or SHA from github/gh-aw to its full commit SHA
    at compile time and pin the compiled workflow to that immutable SHA.
    Equivalent to --action-mode release --action-tag <resolved-sha>.
    Branch and tag names are resolved via the GitHub API.
    Cannot be combined with --action-tag or --action-mode.
    Use this when E2E-testing compiled workflows against a specific gh-aw revision.

Usage:
  gh aw compile [workflow]... [flags]

Examples:
  gh aw compile                    # Compile all Markdown files
  gh aw compile ci-doctor          # Compile a specific workflow
  gh aw compile ci-doctor daily-plan  # Compile multiple workflows
  gh aw compile workflow.md        # Compile by file path
  gh aw compile .github/workflows  # Compile all workflows in a directory
  gh aw compile --dir custom/workflows  # Compile from custom directory
  gh aw compile ci-doctor --watch     # Watch and auto-compile
  gh aw compile --trial --logical-repo owner/repo  # Compile for trial mode
  gh aw compile --dependabot        # Generate Dependabot manifests
  gh aw compile --dependabot --force  # Force overwrite existing dependabot.yml
  gh aw compile --gh-aw-ref main       # Pin workflows to the SHA of github/gh-aw main at compile time
  gh aw compile --action-tag v1.2.3    # Pin workflows to a specific release tag

Flags:
      --action-mode string             How gh-aw action scripts are referenced in compiled workflows: 'dev' uses local paths (for developing gh-aw itself), 'release' emits SHA-pinned remote refs from github/gh-aw, 'action' uses the github/gh-aw-actions repository. Auto-detected from the binary build type if not specified
      --action-tag string              Pin compiled workflows to a specific version of gh-aw actions. Accepts a full commit SHA or a version tag (e.g. v1, v1.2.3). Sets --action-mode to 'release' unless --action-mode action is also specified. Cannot be combined with --gh-aw-ref; use --gh-aw-ref when you want to resolve a branch or tag name to its current SHA
      --actionlint                     Run actionlint linter on generated .lock.yml files
      --actions-repo string            Override the external actions repository used in action mode (default: github/gh-aw-actions)
      --allow-action-refs              Allow unresolved action refs and emit warnings instead of failing validation
      --approve                        Approve all safe update changes. When strict mode is active (the default), the compiler emits warnings for new restricted secrets or unapproved action additions/removals not present in the existing gh-aw-manifest. Use this flag to approve and skip safe update enforcement
      --dependabot                     Generate dependency manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod) and Dependabot config when dependencies are detected
  -d, --dir string                     Workflow directory (default: $GH_AW_WORKFLOWS_DIR or .github/workflows)
  -e, --engine string                  Override AI engine (copilot, claude, codex, gemini, pi)
      --fail-fast                      Stop at the first validation error instead of collecting all errors
      --fix                            Apply automatic codemod fixes to workflows before compiling
  -f, --force                          Force overwrite of existing dependency files (only applies when --dependabot is set; e.g., dependabot.yml)
      --force-refresh-action-pins      Force refresh of action pins by clearing the cache and resolving all action SHAs from GitHub API
      --force-refresh-container-pins   Force refresh existing container image digest pins before compiling
      --gh-aw-ref string               Pin compiled workflows to a specific branch, tag, or commit SHA of github/gh-aw (e.g. main, my-feature, abc123). Branch and tag names are resolved to their full commit SHA at compile time so the baked-in ref is immutable. Equivalent to --action-mode release --action-tag <resolved-sha>. Cannot be combined with --action-tag or --action-mode. Use this to E2E-test workflows against a specific gh-aw revision
      --ghes                           Enable GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) compatibility mode: emit upload-artifact@v3.2.2 and download-artifact@v3.1.0. Overrides the aw.json ghes field.
      --grant                          Run grant license scanner on container images referenced in compiled .lock.yml files (uses Docker image anchore/grant:v0.6.8@sha256:172463611795f43b77302cdfbd7b3f81295492a7330e0820cfe41c3674920237)
      --grype                          Run grype vulnerability scanner on container images referenced in compiled .lock.yml files (uses Docker image anchore/grype:v0.117.0@sha256:ddf9e9f204049f3a4a0955ef70873cabab6a31432125ad4f20a490b54950a253)
  -h, --help                           Show help for gh aw compile
  -j, --json                           Output results in JSON format
  -l, --logical-repo string            Repository to simulate workflow execution against (for trial mode)
      --models                         Warn when models configured in models or engine.models are absent from the active model inventory
      --no-check-update                Skip checking for gh-aw updates
      --no-emit                        Validate workflow without generating lock files
      --poutine                        Run poutine security scanner on generated .lock.yml files
      --purge                          Delete .lock.yml files that were not regenerated during compilation (only when no specific files are provided)
      --refresh-stop-time              Force regeneration of stop-after times instead of preserving existing values from lock files
      --runner-guard                   Run runner-guard taint analysis scanner on generated .lock.yml files (uses Docker image ghcr.io/vigilant-llc/runner-guard:3.1.5@sha256:2df426ef96d21f1622e05b21329f26bd263fc46110609cefb6afe43457613ac0)
      --schedule-seed string           Override the repository slug (owner/repo) used as seed for fuzzy schedule scattering (e.g., "github/gh-aw"). Bypasses git remote detection entirely. Use this when your git remote is not named "origin" and you have multiple remotes configured
      --shellcheck                     Run shellcheck linting of run step scripts
      --show-all                       Display all compilation errors instead of only the highest-priority subset (default: top 5)
      --staged                         Force all safe-outputs into staged mode
      --stats                          Display statistics table sorted by workflow file size (shows jobs, steps, scripts, and shells)
      --strict                         Override frontmatter to enforce strict mode validation for all workflows (enforces action pinning, network config, safe-outputs, disallows write permissions and deprecated fields). Note: Workflows default to strict mode unless frontmatter sets strict: false
      --syft                           Run syft SBOM scanner on container images referenced in compiled .lock.yml files (uses Docker image anchore/syft:v1.51.0@sha256:678bfa565b60f747aac0f8e964fe5588a24445b8d0a480e91f6efd70020dfbb0)
      --trial                          Enable trial mode compilation (modifies workflows for trial execution)
      --validate                       Enable GitHub Actions workflow schema validation, container image validation, and action SHA validation
      --validate-images                Require Docker to be available for container image validation. Without this flag, container image validation is silently skipped when Docker is not installed or the daemon is not running
  -w, --watch                          Watch for changes to workflow files and recompile automatically
      --yamllint                       Run yamllint YAML linter on generated .lock.yml files (uses Docker image pipelinecomponents/yamllint:latest@sha256:5ab5eb7da0ed5e606b07c1723fc8b275e925189f70ac259b26b7329cb5f8f44d)
      --zizmor                         Run zizmor security scanner on generated .lock.yml files

Global Flags:
      --banner    Display ASCII logo banner with purple GitHub color theme
  -v, --verbose   Enable verbose output showing detailed information
